title: Malta’s history in ten minutes
description: A quick, funny, animated run through Malta’s history: temple builders, Phoenicians, Romans, Arabs, knights, Napoleon, and the British. Renzo Piano rebuilt Valletta’s city gate in 2014.

title: The temple builders
episode: The Rise and Fall of Malta's 5,000-year-old Megalithic Temples
description: An archaeologist on Malta’s stone temples, built from about 3600 BC, older than Stonehenge and the pyramids, and on why the culture that built them disappeared. The finds, including the Sleeping Lady, are in this museum.

title: A temple carved underground
description: The Ħal Saflieni Hypogeum, three levels of chambers cut into the rock around 4000 to 2500 BC and used as a burial place for thousands of people. It was found by workmen in 1902. Tickets sell out weeks ahead.

title: Knights against the Ottoman Empire
episode: Knights VS The Ottoman Empire: The Epic Battle for Malta
description: Dan Snow tours the forts of the Grand Harbour to tell the story of the 1565 siege, when a few hundred knights and several thousand Maltese held off a huge Ottoman force for nearly four months.

title: The fall of Fort St. Elmo
episode: Great Siege of Malta 1565 - Ottoman Wars DOCUMENTARY
description: An animated account of the siege, including the month-long fight for Fort St. Elmo, at the tip of the peninsula where Valletta now stands. Its defenders bought the knights time and died almost to a man.

title: Caravaggio in the Co-Cathedral
episode: Caravaggio at St John's Co-Cathedral, Malta
description: The Co-Cathedral’s own film on Caravaggio’s two paintings in the knights’ church: The Beheading of St. John the Baptist and Saint Jerome Writing. Caravaggio was made a knight in 1608, then expelled months later.

title: The war rooms under the city
episode: Secrets Under Valletta (Lascaris War Rooms - MaltaWalks Guide S01E02)
description: A short tour of the Lascaris War Rooms, tunnels cut beneath the Upper Barrakka Gardens where the RAF directed the air defense of Malta, and where part of the 1943 invasion of Sicily was planned.

title: The tanker Ohio
show: The History Guy: History Deserves to Be Remembered
episode: S.S. Ohio and the Siege of Malta
description: The story of the SS Ohio, an American-built tanker that reached Malta in August 1942 with its fuel, after being torpedoed and bombed, lashed between two destroyers. Crowds cheered it into the harbor from the bastions.

title: The king visits the George Cross island
description: Newsreel of King George VI’s visit to Malta in June 1943, a year after he awarded the island the George Cross for its endurance under bombing. The cross is on Malta’s flag.

title: A Semitic language in the Latin alphabet
description: A linguist explains Maltese, which grew from the Arabic spoken during Arab rule and absorbed Sicilian, Italian, and English words. It became an official language only in 1934.

title: The integration referendum of 1956
description: A 1955 newsreel on the proposal to integrate Malta into the United Kingdom, with seats in the British Parliament. The 1956 referendum was inconclusive, and Malta became independent in 1964.

title: The murder of a journalist
episode: How was Daphne Caruana Galizia murdered?
description: How Daphne Caruana Galizia, Malta’s best-known investigative journalist, was killed by a car bomb in October 2017. Her supporters keep a memorial of photos, candles, and flowers at the Great Siege Monument, opposite the law courts.
